channels.title: Channels
channels.readOnly: Read-only guide. Enable writes in installation config to apply non-secret profile settings.

telegram.title: Telegram
telegram.steps: Create a bot with @BotFather (/newbot), copy the bot token into TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN, add your numeric Telegram user id to TELEGRAM_ALLOWED_USERS (comma-separated), optionally TELEGRAM_HOME_CHANNEL, save the profile .env, apply safe config, then restart the gateway.

slack.title: Slack
slack.steps: Create a Slack app (Socket Mode on), enable bot scopes (chat:write, app_mentions:read, channels:history, im:history, users:read, files:read/write, …), install to the workspace for SLACK_BOT_TOKEN (xoxb-), create an app-level token with connections:write for SLACK_APP_TOKEN (xapp-), add SLACK_ALLOWED_USERS member ids, save and apply, then restart the gateway.

imessage.title: iMessage (BlueBubbles)
imessage.steps: Run BlueBubbles Server on a Mac (Messages signed in, Full Disk Access for BlueBubbles). Copy Server URL and password into BLUEBUBBLES_SERVER_URL and BLUEBUBBLES_PASSWORD, optionally BLUEBUBBLES_ALLOWED_USERS or pairing, apply safe config, restart the gateway, and verify webhook registration in gateway logs.

team.title: Team
team.empty: No recent messages between bots in loaded chats.

roomRouting.title: Room routing
roomRouting.mentionRequired: Mention at least one bot, or switch routing to All bots.
roomRouting.hintMentions: Unaddressed messages are blocked; @mentions choose who answers.
roomRouting.hintFacilitator: A facilitator bot picks who answers when nobody is mentioned.
